pages.text: The Immortal-forging path begins with $(item)Immortal Art Remains$() in the End outer islands. It uses native ore-vein generation, requires a Netherite mining tier, enters the End catalog of the World Shard Collector, and replaces purpur as the End-mode activation block.

pages.title: Immortal Art Remains
pages.text: Find its native veins in the End outer islands. Its hardness and mining speed match Ancient Debris, while tools below Netherite tier cannot obtain its drop.

pages.title: Immortal-Furnace Firing
pages.text: This page deliberately uses the vanilla furnace recipe artwork, but the actual station is the $(thing)Immortal Furnace$(). Furnace and blast-furnace alternatives also turn the remains into Immortal-Forged Alloy Scrap.

pages.title: Alloy Scrap
pages.text: The fired product of Immortal Art Remains. Combine one with a Spirit Crystal for a Nurturing Crystal, or use four in the complete alloy.

pages.title: Nurturing Shortcut
pages.text: One alloy scrap and one Spirit Crystal shapelessly produce one Nurturing Crystal.

pages.title: Immortal-Forged Alloy
pages.text: Shapelessly combine one Nurturing Crystal, four alloy scraps, and four Spirit Iron Ingots. Like Netherite, the alloy cannot burn in fire or lava.

pages.title: Immortal One's Rule
pages.text: At a smithing table use a Spirit Core as template, Ancient Jade as the non-consumed base, and Immortal-Forged Alloy as material. It has no durability and cannot burn. It fits chest, legs, or a creature BODY armor slot; with Curios installed it also fits the charm slot. All paths count only one 10-armor bonus and effect. Other creatures receive Regeneration V and Resistance IV.

pages.title: Spiritual Aura Guard
pages.text: Damage first spends True Yuan at 1:1. If short, Immortal Yuan is exchanged at 64 True Yuan each and excess remains in Xianqiao. Only the part still unpaid after both resources are exhausted reaches health. The state supplies a slotless elytra, ignores fall and elytra-collision damage, and double-tapping jump launches upward when creative flight is unavailable.

pages.title: Immortal Artifact
pages.text: Smith a Spirit Core template, a Spirit Staff base, and Immortal-Forged Alloy while retaining enchantments and state. The result has no durability, cannot burn, and enhances all five wrench, build, mine, teleport, and explore modes.

pages.title: Mode Summary
pages.text: While held in wrench mode, the Immortal Artifact adds 5 blocks of both block and entity interaction reach, synchronized for client crosshair targeting and server validation; the Spirit Instrument wrench does not receive this upgrade. Build mode has no total count cap: it fills the connected surface in server-budgeted tick batches and restores the previous removed layer with Special+Sneak+Use. Mine mode compares the target's real tool speeds and drop checks to select pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, or shears, while use keeps precision collection. Teleport reaches 50 blocks. An enabled artifact in inventory routes opened-container contents into Xianqiao.

pages.title: Information Storage Crystal
pages.text: Stacks to 1. Shift-use on an ImmortalStorage machine saves its configuration, state, and plugins; only the newest snapshot per machine type is retained, and holding the crystal suppresses the machine UI. Normal use pastes a matching snapshot; matching plugins in inventory or Xianqiao are inserted automatically, while absent plugins are skipped. Shift-use on an unstateful block or air clears all records. The tooltip shows saved block names, and other-mod machine configuration/plugin interfaces are supported.

pages.title: Information Storage Crystal Recipe
pages.text: Shapelessly combine Immortal-Forged Alloy Scrap with a Nurturing Crystal.
